text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the ingestion contract for continuous batching/queueing metrics so Console and runtime can ship dashboards + SLIs. Core metrics: batch_size distribution, queue_wait_ms, queue_saturation_pct. Goal: agreed metric names, labels, histogram buckets, retention, and which team emits which piece. See draft doc: https://go/redwood/batching-metrics (WIP)

aron: Do we plan to tag by model_version? that could blow up cardinality if customers have many versions.

maya: Good call. Proposal: model_family (string), deployment_tier (hosted|dedicated|private), pool (hashed small set), and route (optional, only for high-value customers). No per-model-version tag by default.

lee: Runtime side — we can emit with those labels. We have one constraint: no more than 4 high-cardinality labels in the hot pipeline. We can emit an extra "variant" tag at 1% sampling for debugging.

samir: From metrics infra: prefer stable metric names and histogram approach. Don't use summaries. Histograms with explicit buckets + count/sum are easier for aggregation/retention. Also we need to decide on units (ms vs s) and bucket boundaries.

maya: Agreed. Units = milliseconds for queue_wait_ms and seconds for avg token generation? Let's keep queue waits in ms.

lee: Sample payload we can emit (proto/JSON example):
```json
{
  "metric": "redwood.batch.batch_size",
  "type": "histogram",
  "labels": {
    "model_family": "rw-13b",
    "deployment_tier": "hosted",
    "pool": "gpu-pool-7"
  },
  "buckets": [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128],
  "values": {"counts": [100, 45, 12, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0], "sum": 234},
  "ts": 1769994321000
}
```

lee: For wait time:
```json
{
  "metric": "redwood.queue.wait_ms",
  "type": "histogram",
  "labels": {"model_family":"rw-13b","deployment_tier":"hosted","pool":"gpu-pool-7"},
  "buckets": [0,1,2,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000,2000],
  "values": {"counts": [...], "sum": 123456},
  "ts": 1769994321000
}
```

samir: Suggested canonical names & conventions:
- redwood.batch.batch_size (histogram, explicit buckets)
- redwood.queue.wait_ms (histogram, ms, explicit buckets)
- redwood.queue.saturation_pct (gauge, 0-100)
- redwood.batch.in_flight_count (gauge)
- redwood.batch.kvcache_hits (counter)

samir: Buckets recommendation for batch_size: exponential 1..128 as above. For wait_ms use [0,1,2,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000,2000,5000]. Emit count+sum. For percentiles in Console, compute from histogram.

aron: What about aggregation keys for multi-tenant customers? We need to support per-customer rollups but not raw-cardinality retention. Proposal: emit tenant_id hashed to 8 chars as label tenant_h (low-cardinality) and route to long-term aggregated pipeline only for high-commit customers.

maya: Okay. Retention/ingest: raw high-cardinality metrics (per-request with full labels) -> short retention 15d. Aggregated rollups (per-hour by model_family/deployment_tier/pool/tenant_h) -> 90d. samir? cost estimate?

samir: Rough estimate: adding these histograms at our current QPS increases TSDB ingestion by ~18%. If we limit per-request label set to 4 labels and sample debugging variant, cost is manageable. Long-term rollups are cheap.

zara: From Console/UX: we need 50/95/99 percentiles for wait_ms, median and tail for batch_size, and a saturation heatmap by pool over time (hourly). Also want a small "root cause" panel showing kvcache_hit rate vs latency. Make sure metrics and labels allow joins by pool + model_family.

maya: Noted. We'll include those as required SLI outputs.

metrics-bot: Reminder: New metric naming policy v2 requires prefixing with "redwood." and including unit in metric slug or metadata. See https://go/redwood/metrics-policy.

aron: One more: how do rollouts affect these metrics? When we do canary, we should emit label rollout=canary|stable so we can compare. That label should be optional.

lee: We'll add optional `rollout` label and ensure it's low-cardinality. Canary envs will set rollout=canary.

samir: Actionable checklist I propose: 
- Runtime (lee): instrument histograms & gauges with agreed names + buckets (due EOD Wed)
- Infra (samir): add ingestion pipeline config and aggregation job (due Fri)
- Platform/Console (maya/zara): dashboard + SLI queries (draft by Thu)
- Product (zara): confirm percentiles & heatmap layout (Thu)
- Follow-up sync: Friday 10am PT (calendar invite coming)

maya: LGTM. If everyone ok, I'll update the draft doc with the final schema and owners. @lee @samir @zara please ack with :thumbsup: when you have a PR or config ready.

lee: 👍 will have runtime PR by Wednesday afternoon.

samir: 👍 working on ingest config, will post PR link.

zara: 👍 I'll prototype the Console panels with mock data.

maya: Thanks all. Closing thread for now — will follow up with the calendar invite and doc updates.
